title: Each A/P report has the Export menu with PDF and CSV
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Each of the three A/P reports has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Finance > A/P Summary and hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  2. Click the ⋯ button and read the menu.
  3. Close the menu and look along the title row and the filter row for a Print button.
  4. Open Reports > Finance > A/P Detail and hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  5. Click the ⋯ button and read the menu.
  6. Close the menu and look along the title row and the filter row for a Print button.
  7. Open Reports > Finance > A/P Unpaid Invoices and hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  8. Click the ⋯ button and read the menu.
  9. Close the menu and look along the title row and the filter row for a Print button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: A/P Summary shows a ⋯ button at the right of its title row, labelled "Export report".
  • Step 2: the menu offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".
  • Step 3: there is no Print button, and no separate print button: printing is through "Download (PDF)".
  • Step 4: A/P Detail shows a ⋯ button at the right of its title row, labelled "Export report".
  • Step 5: the menu offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".
  • Step 6: there is no Print button, and no separate print button: printing is through "Download (PDF)".
  • Step 7: A/P Unpaid Invoices shows a ⋯ button at the right of its title row, labelled "Export report".
  • Step 8: the menu offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".
  • Step 9: there is no Print button, and no separate print button: printing is through "Download (PDF)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • Out of Scope: “A/P print from a separate print button. A/P printing is delivered through the Export menu's PDF (SV-6163).”
